from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, RootModel
from shop import Item, Status


class Order(BaseModel):
    item: Item
    status: Status
    legacy_item_type: Any = Field(None, title='Legacy Item Type')
    legacy_status_type: Any = Field(None, title='Legacy Status Type')


class Basket(BaseModel):
    item: Item
    legacy_item_type: Any = Field(None, title='Legacy Item Type')


class Model(RootModel[Order | Basket]):
    root: Order | Basket
